purpose: Cost of correctness-verified primitive table-function bridges and default custom scalar inference under the accepted UDF exception; no acceleration claim.
method: Same complete-job boundaries as the temporal matrix: symmetric EXPLAIN before timing; execution includes row source, callback/conversion/owned writes, blackhole and both transposes. Baseline is immutable pre-goal canonical f5274a10 with identical fixture-only copies and unchanged production Java. Candidate asserts native target work, both transposes and no fallback; previous enabled controls assert zero native substitutions/work. Preparation and measurements are serialized; no other build/test from this goal overlaps timing.

limitations: Short jobs include startup/JIT variability; independent JVM stock controls can drift.
CPU resources are not reserved; significant sampled background processes are retained per series.
Pre-goal canonical baseline f5274a10 precedes both conversion PR increments.
